messages:
Rita (PM): Quick sync: customers keep seeing saved-view previews differ from live runs. Need narrower surface changes for console.
Diego (FE): Repro: preview panel shows cost/latency for pinned model but runtime routing sometimes picks a fallback. UX gets confusing.
Priya (BE): Root cause: preview API returns a single effective_model today and we cache it. If routing policy or catalog changes later, live calls differ.
Hank (SRE): Caching note: include policy_version and catalog_checksum in cache key and publish invalidation on changes. TTL alone won't cut it.
Rita (PM): Product decision: preview should surface both the pinned/requested model and the runtime effective model, plus a small warning when they differ.
Diego (FE): UI plan: show two-line model row: "Pinned: X • Effective: Y (reason)" and a colored quota pill with hover showing assumptions. Add "Preview as routed" CTA.
Priya (BE): API sketch (backwards compatible): add fields requested_model, effective_model, policy_version, route_decision_id, quota_risk (low|med|high), cache_version. No breaking change if missing.
Sam (Telemetry): We'll emit events saved_view.preview.requested and .preview.effective and saved_view.mismatch with fallback_reason (quota/region/capacity). Also log route_decision_id for correlation.
Rita (PM): Rollouts: do NOT auto-rewrite pinned models. Offer suggested_migrations endpoint that returns safe alternatives with diffs (latency/tokens/cost) and a safety_score.
Priya (BE): Gate suggestions by org capability (model_catalog_sync). Also include migration opt-in flag in API.
Diego (FE): Implementation notes: honor cache_version header to avoid flash of stale preview. If mismatch detected, show subtle banner and an action to re-evaluate.
Hank (SRE): For batch jobs triggered from saved views, ensure job-runner uses same route decision library and stores route_decision_id for traceability.
Rita (PM): Action items: Priya add preview fields + migrations endpoint (ETA 4d), Sam add telemetry + dashboard (ETA 3d), Diego prototype UI + handle cache_version (ETA 1wk), Hank publish invalidation hook (ETA 5d).
ops-bot: staging deploy started build-2026.11 :rocket:
Rita (PM): Thanks — drop any multi-model or embeddings edge cases here and we'll triage next sprint.
